sn35.235:1.4: varaṃ bhikkhave tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sañjotibhūtāya cakkhundriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ na tveva cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.
sn35.235:1.5: nimittassādagadhitaṃ vā bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya anubyañjanassādagadhitaṃ vā bhikkhave tasmiṃ ce samaye kālaṃ kareyya. ṭhānametaṃ vijjati yaṃ dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ gaccheyya
sn35.235:1.7: imaṃ khohaṃ bhikkhave ādīnavaṃ disvā evaṃ vadāmi.
sn35.235:2.1: varaṃ bhikkhave tiṇhena ayosaṅkunā ādittena sampajjalitena sañjotibhūtena sotindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ na tveva sotaviññeyyesu saddesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.
sn35.235:2.2: nimittassādagadhitaṃ vā bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya anubyañjanassādagadhitaṃ vā tasmiṃ ce samaye kālaṃ kareyya. ṭhānametaṃ vijjati yaṃ dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ gacchenya
sn35.235:2.4: imaṃ khohaṃ bhikkhave ādīnavaṃ disvā evaṃ vadāmi.
sn35.235:3.1: varaṃ bhikkhave tiṇhena nakhacchedanena ādittena sampajjalitena sañjotibhūtena ghānindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ na tveva ghānaviññeyyesu gandhesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.
sn35.235:3.2: nimittassādagadhitaṃ vā bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya anubyañjanassādagadhitaṃ vā tasmiṃ ce samaye kālaṃ kareyya.
sn35.235:3.3: ṭhānametaṃ vijjati yaṃ dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ gaccheyya
sn35.235:3.5: imaṃ khohaṃ bhikkhave ādīnavaṃ disvā evaṃ vadāmi.
sn35.235:4.1: varaṃ bhikkhave tiṇhena khurena ādittena sampajjalitena sañjotibhūtena jivhindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ na tveva jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.
sn35.235:4.2: nimittassādagadhitaṃ vā bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya anubyañjanassādagadhitaṃ vā tasmiṃ ce samaye kālaṃ kareyya.
sn35.235:4.3: ṭhānametaṃ vijjati yaṃ dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ gaccheyya
sn35.235:4.5: imaṃ khohaṃ bhikkhave ādīnavaṃ disvā evaṃ vadāmi.
sn35.235:5.1: varaṃ bhikve tiṇhāya sattiyā ādittāya sampajjalitāya sañjotibhūtāya kāyindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ na tveva kāyaviññeyyesu phoṭṭhabbesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.
sn35.235:5.2: nimittassādagadhitaṃ vā bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya anubyañjanassādagadhitaṃ vā tasmiṃ ce samaye kālaṃ kareyya.
sn35.235:5.3: ṭhānametaṃ vijjati yaṃ dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ gaccheyya
sn35.235:5.5: imaṃ khohaṃ bhikkhave ādīnavaṃ disvā evaṃ vadāmi.
sn35.235:6.2: sottaṃ kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave vajjaṃ jīvitānaṃ vadāmi aphalaṃ jīvitānaṃ vadāmi momūhaṃ jīvitānaṃ vadāmi na tveva tathārūpe vitakke vitakkeyya yathārūpānaṃ vitakkānaṃ vasaṅgato saṅghaṃ bhindeyya.
sn35.235:6.3: imaṃ khohaṃ bhikkhave vajjaṃ jīvitānaṃ ādīnavaṃ disvā evaṃ vadāmi.
sn35.235:7.1: tattha bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
sn35.235:7.2: tiṭṭhatu tāva tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sañjotibhūtāya cakkhundriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ
sn35.235:7.4: iti cakkhuṃ aniccaṃ rūpā aniccā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ cakkhusamphasso anicco yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccaṃ.
sn35.235:8.1: tiṭṭhatu tāva tiṇhena ayosaṅkunā ādittena sampajjalitena sañjotibhūtena sotindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ
sn35.235:8.3: iti sotaṃ aniccaṃ saddā aniccā sotaviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ sotasamphasso anicco yampidaṃ sotasamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccaṃ.
sn35.235:9.1: tiṭṭhatu tāva tiṇhena nakhacchedanena ādittena sampajjalitena sañjotibhūtena ghānindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ
sn35.235:9.3: iti ghānaṃ aniccaṃ gandhā aniccā ghānaviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ ghānasamphasso anicco yampidaṃ ghānasamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ …pe… tampi aniccaṃ.
sn35.235:10.1: tiṭṭhatu tāva tiṇhena khurena ādittena sampajjalitena sañjotibhūtena jivhindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ
sn35.235:10.3: iti jivhā aniccā rasā aniccā jivhāviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ jivhāsamphasso anicco yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati …pe… tampi aniccaṃ.
sn35.235:11.1: tiṭṭhatu tāva tiṇhāya sattiyā ādittāya sampajjalitāya sañjotibhūtāya kāyindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ
sn35.235:11.3: iti kāyo anicco phoṭṭhabbā aniccā kāyaviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ kāyasamphasso anicco yampidaṃ kāyasamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ …pe… tampi aniccaṃ.
sn35.235:12.3: iti mano anicco dhammā aniccā manoviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ manosamphasso anicco yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccaṃ.
sn35.235:13.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃpi nibbindati rūpesupi nibbindati cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati …pe…
sn35.235:13.2: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmiṃpi nibbindati
sn35.235:13.3: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.235:13.4: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
